parts.effect: Whenever an attack with **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** is allocated to one of the unit's **CHARACTER** models while the unit still has a Bodyguard model, roll a D6. data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

**Target:** An **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** [Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units) of yours that is a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** Whenever an attack with **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** is allocated to one of the unit's **CHARACTER** models while the unit still has a Bodyguard model, roll a D6. On a 2+, you pick a Bodyguard model in the unit to take that attack instead. This applies for the rest of the phase.
